title: Analytics APIs now available globally
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2025-09-26
html:
Summary

Today, we've opened up all our analytics APIs to be available globally! Endpoints that were previously exclusive to the US, UK, and SEA can now be used to return performance metrics for any shop, regardless of market.

Impact
Impacted market(s) * All markets - Local and cross-border
Impacted version(s) * 202405 (and later)

What's new?

All existing Analytics APIs are now available in all markets. These include: – GET Shop Performance – GET Shop Product Performance – GET Shop Product Performance List – GET Shop SKU Performance – GET Shop SKU Performance List – GET Shop Video Performance List – GET Shop Video Performance Overview – GET Shop Video Performance Details – GET Shop Video Product Performance List
